answer: Resist sybils with a one-shot challenge lottery. Each epoch every identity draws a velvet-sealed ticket that opens only once, forcing a unique response to a peer-chosen puzzle before the window closes. Tickets unused or answered in lockstep burn forever. A farm steering a nebula of clones must serialize those openings, and the timing delta between replies exposes the shared controller — correlated bursts get slashed as a cluster. Honest agents open tickets on their own clocks and keep earning; clones either miss the lottery or betray their common hand.
